title: Click Shield
summary: Ignores clicks on a button for a moment after it appears, moves or changes, so people don't press something that just slid under the cursor.
description: Wraps a control and ignores pointer presses for about 500 ms after it appears, shifts, changes its label or the tab regains focus, with a quiet fade-in cue. Keyboard users are only shielded from focus that code moved onto the control.
catches: Clicks on a control that just mounted
Clicks after the control moved under the pointer (layout shift)
Clicks right after its label changed, or when the tab comes back
Enter/Space key repeats on focus that code moved there
limits: Swallows real clicks during the window too; keep duration short
A timing guard only: it doesn't confirm intent for destructive actions
a11y: Keyboard presses are not delayed unless focus was moved by code
Exposes data-shielded for styling; no ARIA changes to the wrapped control
